title: SafeTy and Outcome of contemPorary Treatment Strategies for Cardiogenic SHOCK
official: SafeTy and Outcome of contemPorary Treatment Strategies for Cardiogenic SHOCK - an International, Observational Registry
summary: International, observational registry to investigate the outcome in patients with cardiogenic shock. The primary aim of this study is to investigate the clinical outcome of patients in cardiogenic shock.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with cardiogenic shock treated at a tertiary care hospital.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Age ≤17 years.
